name: Lotila Lighthouse
title: Lotila Lighthouse
summary: An unlit Empyrean lighthouse on the west coast of Lotila Island at 79.2N 76.8W: a 73 m black stone tower, 20 x 20 m, on a 40 m bluff above the shore and the open sea.

landmarks.name: Lotila Lighthouse

site.name: Lotila Lighthouse
site.notes: Derived @teleloc on the grassy shore terrace 64 m north-west of the lighthouse (ground 6.0, no object within 40 m, a creature generator 18 m away); the gazetteer only has a map @tele for it.

shots.standingOrder: Lock off 10 m above the shore slope 43 m north of Lotila Lighthouse and tilt up from its rocky bluff to the black 73 m tower's lantern roof against the sky, the sea at frame right.
shots.notes: Tilt. A locked lens 10 m above the shore slope, 43 m north of the lighthouse, tilts from +24 deg to +60 deg. It climbs from the rocky bluff up the 73 m black tower to its roof against the sky, with the sea at frame right and the noon sun high overhead.
